warnings: Early‑morning fog in December can obscure views at Top Station – have a backup indoor activity (Tea Museum) ready.
Official boat ride at Mattupetty Dam is ₹150 per adult; avoid unlicensed operators charging up to ₹400.
Taxi rates from Kochi Airport to Munnar are fixed (₹3,200‑₹3,500). Confirm price in writing before boarding.
Taxi from Kochi Airport to Munnar is a fixed‑rate ₹3,200–₹3,500 for 130 km; negotiate before boarding as there is no meter. Mitigation: confirm price in writing or use a reputable booking service.

Local taxis within Munnar typically charge ₹12–₹15 per km; a 30 km round trip usually costs ₹500–₹800. Auto‑rickshaws quote ₹15 per km with a “minimum fare” of ₹100 for short hops. Mitigation: ask for a meter, or agree on a total fare beforehand.

Unlicensed boat operators at Mattupetty Dam often charge ₹300–₹400 per ride, claiming “premium” service. Official boat entry is ₹150 adult (₹100 child) and includes a 15‑minute ride. Mitigation: use the official dam office ticket counter and verify the boat’s registration number.

Premium Shikara rides at Kundala Lake are advertised at ₹250, but the official rate is ₹120 (₹80 child). Operators may add undisclosed “guide fees”. Mitigation: purchase the standard ticket at the lake office and negotiate any extra fee up front.
Boat rides at Mattupetty Dam halt during the heavy monsoon (June‑August); December is safe but check local conditions before heading out.
Top Station visibility drops sharply during heavy fog (December‑January); plan sunrise visits early and have a backup indoor activity.

Some guided tour operators claim a combined entry fee of ₹500 for the waterfall and farm, but the official combined ticket is only ₹70. Purchase separate tickets at each gate and ask for a receipt to avoid overcharging.
Tourist‑spot transport pricing can inflate: local taxis at ₹12‑₹15 per km and auto‑rickshaws with a ₹100 minimum fare. Confirm distances and agree on fares in advance.
